subheaders.label: Multimodal
subheaders.description: Models processing and generating multiple modalities simultaneously (text, vision, audio, document OCR).

subheaders.label: Computer Vision
subheaders.description: Visual perception, image generation, segmentation, classification, and depth estimation models.

subheaders.label: NLP
subheaders.description: Language models spanning causal text generation, embeddings, semantic search, and classification.

subheaders.label: Tabular
subheaders.description: Models trained on structured row-and-column data for tabular classification, regression, and scoring.

subheaders.label: Machine Learning
subheaders.description: Classical machine learning pipelines, tree-based models, gradient boosting, and scikit-learn architectures.

subheaders.label: Deep Learning
subheaders.description: Foundational neural network frameworks, raw weights, tensor runtimes, and deep representation architectures.

subheaders.label: Statistical
subheaders.description: Time-series forecasting, econometric models, and probabilistic statistical regression engines.

subheaders.label: Data Analyst models
subheaders.definitionNote: How this category is defined: Curated pipeline targeting automated data analysis, SQL query generation (text-to-sql), natural language table exploration (Tapas / Table QA), and automated reporting.

subheaders.label: Data Engineering models
subheaders.definitionNote: How this category is defined: Curated pipeline targeting ETL pipelines, high-throughput entity extraction (NER), semantic record deduplication, text normalization, and high-density vector search embeddings.
